sentences.text: The product note says that for individual borrowers on floating-rate loans for non-business purposes, no foreclosure charge applies.

The Retail Loan Policy evidence available only defines “foreclosure” as pre-payment of the loan in full and does not state any foreclosure charge for this borrower type, so agreement cannot be confirmed from the cited policy text.
